comment: Pass thresholds for the owner-regression live suite, written 2026-11-04 BEFORE the first run and not tuned after seeing results (lane REGR TASK.md item 2b). A scenario meets its target on a model when passes >= min_passes out of `runs` reps. The release gate (tools/release_gate/check_owner_regressions.py) requires every non-xfail scenario to meet its target on each gate model. xfail marks a row whose fix is still open on main (loop freshness, loop cancellation); the rows whose fixes were in flight in UPSERT, FSCAP and PROG were flipped to required when those lanes landed (0cefb9d3, fd75210d, a305cbfc), and lc-routine-content / lc-unasked-topic were flipped after REGR-RUN-2 met them 5/5 on claude-haiku-5-5 and glm-5.3 on bf40a3ed (a stale xfail must be flipped, not left skipping).
